newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HMO stocks downgraded by Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HMO stocks downgraded by Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said Monday it cut intermediate-term ratings on Aetna Inc, United HealthCare Corp, WellPoint Health Networks Inc and PacifiCare Health Systems Inc.

-- The ratings on Aetna, United HealthCare and WellPoint were lowered to an intermediate-term accumulate from a buy, Merrill Lynch said. It said it was maintaining a long-term buy rating on the stocks.
-- PacifiCare was lowered to an intermediate-term neutral from an accumulate rating, the firm said. It said it was keeping a long-term buy rating on PacifiCare.
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- Shares of Aetna were off 2-1/8 at 110-1/2, shares of United HealthCare were off 1-3/4 at 54-3/8, WellPoint shares were off two points at 48-3/4 and shares of PacifiCare were down 1-1/8 at 80-1/2.
